items.title: 65% of gen z would do an all-sides thanksgiving
items.body: in a Campbell's report, 65% of gen z said they'd happily eat a thanksgiving dinner made entirely of side dishes. honestly same.

items.title: 41% say friendsgiving matters as much
items.body: 41% of gen z say friendsgiving is as meaningful as family thanksgiving, or more. they're about twice as likely as everyone else to pick it as their favorite.

items.title: gochujang on everything
items.body: tastewise data says about 1 in 10 gen z thanksgiving dishes are spicy, mini, deviled, mashed, barbecued or gluten-free. gochujang brussels sprouts and harissa honey carrots are all over tiktok.

items.title: matching table settings are OUT
items.body: gen z hosts are mixing heirloom pieces with modern ones, doing themed potlucks, and skipping orange mums and rust-colored everything.
